$comment-1: QuantConnect LEAN project config for v1_trend_following.
$comment-2: POST-PIVOT 2026-05-12 (Pivot-PR-A): canonical deploy path is LEAN Local in a Dockerized container on the operator's VPS. The pre-pivot 'QC Cloud' path is RETIRED — QC's /object/get is gated behind the Institutional subscription tier (DP-025), so the QC-Cloud-mediated Phase 1 architecture is no longer feasible.
$comment-3: POST-CEREMONY 2026-05-12: LEAN-side broker swapped from InteractiveBrokersBrokerage → PaperBrokerage. The bare quantconnect/lean:latest image does NOT ship QuantConnect.Brokerages.InteractiveBrokers.dll, so live-mode boot threw `Sequence contains no matching element` from LEAN's Composer broker-factory lookup. PaperBrokerage is LEAN's built-in zero-dependency simulator. The api owns the real IBKR broker contract via services/execution/ibkr_adapter.py — LEAN only generates signals + POSTs them.
$comment-rollback-2026-05-20-v2: DATA-LAYER PIVOT v2 (Option C of the 2026-05-20 v2 architecture; supersedes the v1 attempt in PRs #195 + #196 + #197). The v1 ambition (LEAN reads delayed quotes directly from IBKR via the QC `InteractiveBrokersBrokerage` data-queue-handler on clientId=10) was blocked by the QC plugin's IBAutomater design (the plugin tries to LAUNCH its own gateway rather than connect to an existing one — incompatible with the api's clientId=1 ownership of the ib_gateway sidecar). Option C reverts the data-queue-handler + history-provider to the original `FakeDataQueue` + `SubscriptionDataReaderHistoryProvider` shape; api now owns the bar-fetch responsibility via `services/data/bar_sync.py` (BarSyncWorker on clientId=2; daily 17:00 ET cycle; writes to the shared `lean_data` Docker volume). The 9 ib-* keys + job-user-id + api-access-token from the v1 attempt are removed. See `Docs/decisions-log.md` 2026-05-20 evening entry + the v2 landing entry.
$comment-5: Post-pivot deploy: docker compose up -d lean_local. The container's entrypoint resolves sops bundle → env vars LEAN_LOCAL_BEARER_TOKEN, then deep-merges this template on top of upstream LEAN's config.json and launches LEAN Launcher.
$comment-6: Brokerage: PaperBrokerage (live-mode). LEAN simulates fills locally; the strategy never calls broker-mutating APIs (market_order / limit_order / etc.) — it only emits signals via HTTP POST to the api. The api dispatches approved signals to IBKR via ib-async (services/execution/ibkr_adapter.py) on clientId=1.
$comment-7: Strategy logic in strategies/v1_trend_following/ is broker-agnostic and runs identically under any of these environments.
$comment-algorithm-location: LEAN Local reads this field — the file was renamed from v1_qc_algorithm.py to v1_strategy.py post-pivot (Pivot-PR-A Q3 resolution). The QC Cloud deploy path is retired so the dual-filename pattern from the pre-pivot README is no longer needed.
description: v1_trend_following — Donchian/MA/EfficiencyRatio/ATR trend strategy on Phase 1 sub-universe (CME micro futures + bond ETFs). Daily resolution, 17:30 ET signal cycle. Runs locally via LEAN Local + PaperBrokerage (for fills) + FakeDataQueue + SubscriptionDataReaderHistoryProvider (reads on-disk bars written by the api's BarSyncWorker on clientId=2 at 17:00 ET; data-layer-pivot-v2 architecture per `services/data/bar_sync.py`).
$comment-parameters: Mirrors strategies/v1_trend_following/parameters.py V1_DEFAULTS. The algorithm reads them via self.get_parameter(...) with V1_DEFAULTS as fallback. Keys are the canonical agent `tighten_parameter` enum names (backend-spec §12.3) — never rename without a parameter_sets migration.

environments.$comment: LEAN Local environments. The `lean_local` Docker container's entrypoint deep-merges this section on top of the upstream `/Lean/Launcher/bin/Debug/config.json` defaults (Pivot-PR-F). Post data-layer pivot v2 (Option C; 2026-05-20 evening): handler bindings revert to the original `FakeDataQueue` + `SubscriptionDataReaderHistoryProvider` shape. LEAN reads on-disk bars written by the api's BarSyncWorker (see services/data/bar_sync.py) — clean separation between the api's IBKR ownership (orders on clientId=1, bars on clientId=2) and LEAN's read-only on-disk consumption. Production env is selected at runtime via `LEAN_LIVE_MODE`: `false` (default) → backtesting, `true` → paper-internal.

backtesting.$comment: Backtest against QC bundled historical bars. Used in CI golden tests + ad-hoc parameter sweeps. No broker dependency. Inherits backtesting handlers from upstream config.json defaults via the entrypoint deep-merge.

paper-internal.$comment-1: Live-mode operation under LEAN's built-in PaperBrokerage simulator. No real exchange connection from LEAN's order side — the strategy never places orders (the api owns broker contract via services/execution/ibkr_adapter.py on clientId=1). PaperBrokerage satisfies the IBrokerage interface for LEAN's internal subscription + scheduling machinery; portfolio queries return flat positions (LEAN doesn't own positions post-pivot; the api does).
paper-internal.$comment-2: DATA-LAYER PIVOT v2 (Option C; 2026-05-20 evening): `data-queue-handler` = `FakeDataQueue` (LEAN's built-in no-op live queue; the strategy doesn't need streaming ticks — all decisions are daily-resolution and derive from `self.history(...)` reads). `history-provider` = `[SubscriptionDataReaderHistoryProvider]` (reads on-disk daily bars from `/Lean/Data/`, populated by the api's BarSyncWorker via the shared `lean_data` Docker volume mount). The api fetches bars from IBKR via ib-async on clientId=2 daily at 17:00 ET; LEAN's 17:30 ET signal cycle reads the fresh data. See Docs/decisions-log.md 2026-05-20 evening entry for the full architecture + v1 attempt postmortem.
paper-internal.$comment-3: transaction-handler stays `BacktestingTransactionHandler` because PaperBrokerage simulates fills internally — not BrokerageTransactionHandler.
